chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who became junub and then performed ghusl before urinating, after which something came out of him. He said: "He repeats the ghusl." I said: Then what of a woman, from whom something comes out after ghusl? He said: "She does not repeat the ghusl." I said: What is the difference between them? He said: "Because what comes out of the woman is only from the man's fluid."

key_terms.أَجْنَبَ: became in a state of janabah requiring ritual purification
key_terms.الْغُسْلَ: the ritual bath performed for purification

ai.seo_question: Does a person need to repeat ghusl if something comes out after ghusl al-janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on ghusl after janabah when discharge appears afterward. It distinguishes between the man and the woman, ruling that the man repeats ghusl if something exits after washing before urinating, while the woman does not repeat ghusl because what exits from her is regarded here as the man's fluid.
